item.title: Statement by Minister Olszewski to launch Fire Prevention Week 2026
item.description: Today, the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, issued the following statement.

item.title: Minister Anandasangaree highlights new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada
item.description: Today, the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, participated in an event highlighting how the federal government is helping Canadian businesses of all sizes invest in new equipment, adopt new technology, expand their operations, and compete at home and around the world. This will create the conditions for a new era of investment in Canada.

item.title: Secretary of State Sahota highlights new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada
item.description: Canada has what the world wants: abundant energy and critical minerals, the most educated workforce in the world, access to 1.5 billion consumers through our free trade agreements, and the strongest fiscal position in the G7. We are building on these advantages to make Canada the best place in the world to invest, build, and grow.

item.title: Minister Anandasangaree highlights in Stoney Creek new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, along with Lisa Hepfner, Member of Parliament for Hamilton Mountain, to highlight how the Government of Canada is helping Canadian businesses of all sizes invest in new equipment, adopt new technology, expand their operations, and compete at home and around the world.

item.title: Government of Canada appoints permanent Correctional Investigator
item.description: David Paradiso is an accomplished executive leader with 35 years of experience in public sector oversight, legal analysis and independent investigations. He has advanced fairness, accountability and organizational performance across multiple Canadian jurisdictions and is well-positioned to lead the OCI on a permanent basis.

item.title: Government of Canada advances cyber resilience through public-private partnerships
item.description: Today, Public Safety Canada and the Communications Security Establishment Canada co-chaired the first in-person meeting of the Canadian Cyber Defence Collective, uniting public & private sector partners to strengthen Canada’s defence against cyber threats.

item.title: Government of Canada invests in gun violence prevention in Halifax, Nova Scotia
item.description: The Government of Canada is taking action to protect Canadians from gun and gang violence. A key part of that action is providing direct support to communities throughout the country.

item.title: Minister Anandasangaree to announce funding to support efforts in preventing gun and gang violence in Halifax
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, for an announcement about the Government of Canada’s efforts to keep Canadian communities safe.

item.title: Government of Canada reports on continued progress in fight against auto theft
item.description: Today, the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, released an update on the progress made under the National Action Plan on Combatting Auto Theft (Action Plan).
